baseline_scope: Frozen release renderer from 2026-10-11 14:30, before all built-in pipeline migrations. This measures cumulative filter-pipeline migration plus completion of the public interface and removal of Filter::Program, not only the last private-bound-constructor change.

protocol.mode: Both release libraries linked into one driver; separate contexts on the same physical GPU; one frame per variant in alternating order each iteration, with all work serial and waited. Three trials reverse the initial order. NativeRenderer drawing, resource recording, filtering/composition, submission and wait are timed; compilation and readback excluded. Metal validation disabled. Single CPU rendering thread; no parallel build/test work during measurements.

workloads.common: 128 translucent rounded rectangles (220x145, radius12, alpha150) over a solid background. Canvas1280x800, except blur_4k3840x2160. Source positions use x=i*83 mod width, y=i*47 mod height. RGB=(i*23,i*51,i*97) mod256.
workloads.ordinary: Scene only, used as a system-noise control.
workloads.blur_4k: Full3840x2160 backdrop Gaussian sigma12, BlurSampling::default(). This default-convolution workload differs from earlier downsampled benchmark scenes.
workloads.glass: Full-canvas built-in RectLiquidGlass with blur_radius12 and otherwise defaults.
workloads.progressive: Vertical ProgressiveBlur from(0,0) to(0,height), max sigma24.
workloads.shadow: Source rect(240,160)-(1000,640), radius32, drop shadow offset(12,8), sigma8, black alpha180.
workloads.color_chain: Brightness1.05, Contrast0.95, Grayscale0.1, HueRotate0.2, Invert0.1, Saturate0.9, Sepia0.1, Opacity0.95 in one filter chain.
workloads.program_glass: Unmodified examples/common/program_glass.rs and examples/shaders/glass.*; center/half-size(640,400), radius24, dispersion enabled.
workloads.program_brush: Coordinates shader on rect(80,60)-(1200,740), radius24, uniforms[.001,.001,0,1].

preliminary_separate_process.interpretation: Retained for transparency; not used for final steady-execution conclusions. Process-level sequential runs showed large time-dependent shifts, including the unchanged ordinary drawing control. The paired per-frame protocol above reduces that confounding. No samples were discarded from either protocol.

validation.presentation: Metal window,8 frames and resize smoke passed
validation.lint: release Metal all-target clippy completed; existing5 library and22 library-test warnings
validation.platform_limitations: No DXC installation or DX12/Vulkan device available; HLSL reflection host tests pass, but native DX12/Vulkan device execution is not claimed.

interpretation: The same-process, alternating-frame comparison shows filter p50 differences from -1.90% to +0.39% on the measured workloads; ordinary drawing control is +0.14%. Program brush rises by 0.01579ms (+1.74%). This is small but is reported as measured overhead, not zero cost. The blur_large gain varies by trial and is not a general speedup claim. Absolute times drift across trials, so use paired differences and retained raw samples rather than comparing separate processes.
